section: An CCDM Reveal.js Theme for Quarto
text:
An CCDM Reveal.js Theme for Quarto
This Quarto extension allows you to create your slides using a theme that follows CCDM typography and colour styles and provides the official CCDM logo and cover image for the title slide.

title: CCDM
text:
Figures with {ggplot2}

#Prepare data

library(gapminder)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

facet <- gapminder |>
  filter(continent != "Americas") |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarise(pop = sum(as.numeric(pop)))

#Make plot
ggplot() +
  geom_area(data = facet, aes(x = year, y = pop, fill = continent)) +
  facet_wrap(~continent, ncol = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 2000000000, 4000000000),
    labels = c(0, "2bn", "4bn")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 1, colour = "#474747") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Asia's rapid growth",
    subtitle = "Population growth by continent, 1952-2007"
  )

title: CBADA Quarto Templates Extension
text:
The CCDMQuarto Quarto extension provides official Analytics for the Australian Grains Industry (CCDM) project theming for Quarto documents. If you prefer to use R Markdown, please see the excellent {CCDMTemplates} package, which CCDMQuarto has feature parity with and shares the same underlying CCDM templates for the individual CCDM documents so that the outputs should be similar if not identical between these two tools. CCDMQuarto was developed to provide next-generation literate programming tools for CCDM’s reporting and presentation needs that support R, Python and Julia languages.


See the included template and demo file for each format here:



CCDM PDF Short Report: CCDM PDF Short Report Demo (Source)
CCDM PDF Report: CCDM PDF Report Demo (Source)
CCDM Word Document Report: CCDM Word Document Demo (Source)
CCDM Word Document Short Report: CCDM Word Document Short Demo (Source)





CCDM revealjs Presentation: CCDM revealjs Slide Demo (Source) (this is an CCDMQuarto exclusive)
CCDM PowerPoint Presentation: CCDM PPT Slide Demo (Source)







If you do not have Quarto installed on your device (and are not already using RStudio, which includes it by default), you will need to do that first. Go here for instructions on how to install Quarto.



Use your terminal or command prompt to run the install commands. Alternatively, if you use RStudio or VS Code(ium)/Positron you can use the terminal emulator, but not the R/Python/Julia REPL (read-eval-print-loop console), in those integrated development environments (IDE) to run the commands. Or, if you prefer and you are using Windows, you may need to install the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) to use the bash command. For more information, see Microsoft’s documentation.
You can obtain a copy of the extension by using the following commands in your Bash terminal (CLI):
cd your_quarto_project_folder
quarto use template CCDM-CBADA/CBADAQuarto
This will install the extension and create an example qmd file that you can use as a starting place for your LaTeX PDF, MS Word .docx or reveal.js presentation slides.




For documentation on using reveal.js slides in Quarto, please see, https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/.
To use the formatted output, save your qmd file into the extension folder that you created using the command above. Then, in the output format use:

cbada-docx+report, for a full length MS Word report
cbada-docx+short+report, for a short MS Word report
cbada-pptx, for MS PPT output
cbada-revealjs, for a revealjs presentation
cbada-pdf+report, for a full length PDF report
cbada-pdf+short+report, for a short PDF report



If you use the Bash command above to install the extension and create a sub directory following the command prompt, there will be a .qmd file created using the name that you input for the sub directory.
By default, these templates use {CCDMThemes} and {CCDMPalettes} for R graphical and tabular outputs.




As we continue to improve this extension through bug fixes or adding new functionality, you can update it easily like so:
cd your_quarto_project_folder
quarto update CCDM-CBADA/CBADAQuarto
